name: hivemind-persona-agent-plugin
description: ovos-persona (LLM/solver) agent protocol plugin for HiveMind-core — streaming natural_language_query
author: JarbasHiveMind

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
```bash
pip install hivemind-persona-agent-plugin
```

Or from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JarbasHiveMind/hivemind-persona-agent-plugin
cd hivemind-persona-agent-plugin
pip install -e .
```

setup_notes.heading: 2. Configure hivemind-core
Configuration
setup_notes.content:
All keys live under `"hivemind-persona-agent-plugin"` in `server.json`.

| Key       | Type           | Required | Description                                          |
|-----------|----------------|----------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `persona` | string or dict | yes      | Path to a persona JSON file, or an inline persona config. |
